card.name: Unit endings after a number
card.fires_on: The last piece of a measurement unit right after a number, mainly the g in mcg and the Hz in MHz. It also fires weakly on mg and nm after a number.

modes.label: mcg doses
modes.description: The g ending of mcg right after a number in a dose statement.

modes.label: MHz frequency
modes.description: The Hz ending of MHz after a number in radio-band text.

modes.label: Other units
modes.description: The unit mg or nm after a number, in dose ranges or laser wavelengths.

card.plain: It fires on the last letters of a unit such as mcg or MHz when they follow a number.
